needed.evidence: Shops and businesses line the right side, creating a demand for pedestrians to cross, but there is no marked or signalised crossing facility visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with kerb ramps at the frontage of the businesses on the right to provide a safe point of crossing.

needed.evidence: The left side has a purpose-built sidewalk, but there are no visible dropped kerbs to facilitate safe access to the road or a crossing.
needed.suggestion: Construct a raised crossing on the left to provide a level transition for pedestrians and a traffic-calming feature for drivers.

needed.evidence: The surface of the sidewalk on the left appears uneven and poorly maintained, presenting trip hazards for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the sidewalk on the left side to eliminate trip hazards and create a safe, accessible path.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the right side is unpaved and uneven, with visible debris and a lack of a defined surface, creating significant trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Construct a proper, paved footway on the right side to replace the unsafe informal path and provide a safe route for pedestrians.
